title: When Heaven Denies You Everything, You Rewrite Destiny
script: When heaven denies you everything, you don't kneel. You rise. In the world of cultivation, the strong rule and the weak perish. But one man refused to accept his fate. Born with a shattered spirit root, mocked by all, he discovered an ancient secret that would change everything. Today, we tell the story of a cultivator who went from trash to legend. Subscribe, because this journey is only beginning.
